style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted:
Create a winter wonderland atmosphere with the 7ft (2.1m) Flocked Mountain Pine Christmas Tree, featuring lush PVC branches beautifully coated with realistic white flocking that mimics freshly fallen snow. This tree offers a charming, frosted look that adds a magical touch to your holiday décor.

Standing at 7ft (2.1m) tall, the Mountain Pine Flocked Christmas Tree presents a full and natural silhouette, perfect for showcasing your favorite ornaments and lights.

Its sturdy construction ensures easy assembly and lasting enjoyment throughout the festive season.

• **Features:**
• 7ft (2.1m) tall – ideal for medium to large rooms
• PVC branches with white flocking for a snowy effect
• Full, natural shape with frosted elegance
• Sturdy frame for easy setup and stability
• Perfect for traditional and contemporary holiday décor
